```{r setup, include=FALSE}
metadata <- read.delim("data/metadata/mehreen_metadata_fixed.txt",
                       check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- metadata[, !is.na(names(metadata)) & nzchar(names(metadata)),
                     drop = FALSE]
metadata$Diet <- factor(metadata$Diet, levels = c("33", "50", "83"))
metadata$Treatment <- factor(metadata$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Infected"))

counts <- read.csv("data/raw_read_counts/master_counts.csv",
                   check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r metrics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
n_samples <- nrow(metadata)
n_genes <- nrow(counts)
diet_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Diet)), collapse = " / ")
treatment_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Treatment)), collapse = " / ")

cat('<div class="metric-grid">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>samples</strong></div>', n_samples))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>counted genes</strong></div>',
            format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>diet levels</strong></div>', diet_levels))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>treatments</strong></div>', treatment_levels))
cat('</div>')
```
